categories.title: Product categories
categories.description: Which FDA enforcement datasets to search. Leave empty for all three.

reportedAfter.title: Reported on or after
reportedAfter.description: ISO date, e.g. "2026-01-01". Filters on the FDA report date.

classifications.title: Recall classification
classifications.description: FDA severity class. Class I is the most serious.

enumTitles: Class I — serious health consequences or death
Class II — temporary or reversible consequences
Class III — unlikely to cause adverse consequences

maxItems.title: Maximum results
maxItems.description: Stop after this many recall records. Maximum 50000.

recallingFirm.title: Recalling firm
recallingFirm.sectionDescription: All optional. Filters combine with AND.

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Search the recall reason and product description, e.g. "listeria", "undeclared peanut".
